title: Naphthalene Diimide and Bis-Heteroleptic Ru(II) Complex-Based Hybrid Molecule with 3-in-1 Functionalities.
authors: Rashid, Ambreen; Mondal, Sahidul; Musha Islam, Abu Saleh; Mondal, Subal; Ghosh, Pradyut
one_liner_zh: 该文研究含NDI的Ru(II)双金属配合物与CT-DNA的结合及光催化性能，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系中的DNA结合（嵌插与沟槽）并采用分子对接，但对象为小分子-DNA而非蛋白质-DNA，且方法以光谱和DFT为主，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Multipurpose applications of a newly developed homobimetallic Ru(II) complex, Ru-NDI[PF(6)](4), which incorporates 1,10-phenanthroline and triazole-pyridine ligands and linked via a (-CH(2)-)(3) spacer to the reputed anion-pi interacting NDI system, are described. Solution-state studies of the bimetallic complex, including EPR, PL, UV-vis, and NMR experiments, reveal two sequential one-electron transfers to the NDI unit, generating NDI⋅(-) and NDI(2-) in the presence of F(-) selectively. This process inhibits the primary electron transfer from Ru(II) to the NDI unit, thereby allowing the (3)MLCT-based emission of the complex to be recovered, resulting in a corresponding ten-fold increase in luminescence intensity. DFT and TD-DFT computational studies further elucidate the experimentally observed absorption spectra of the complex. Secondly, CT-DNA binding studies with the complex are performed using various spectroscopic analyses such as UV-vis, PL, and CD. Comparative DNA binding studies employing EB and molecular docking reveal that the binding with CT-DNA occurs through both intercalative and groove binding modalities. Thirdly, the photocatalytic activities of the complex towards C-C, C-N, and C-O bond formation in organic cross-coupling reactions, including the amidation of alpha-keto acids to amines and the oxidation of alcohol to aldehydes, are also demonstrated.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一种新开发的双金属Ru(II)配合物Ru-NDI[PF(6)](4)的多功能应用，该配合物包含1,10-菲咯啉和三唑-吡啶配体，并通过(-CH(2)-)(3)间隔基连接到著名的阴离子-π相互作用NDI系统。对双金属配合物的溶液态研究，包括EPR、PL、UV-vis和NMR实验，揭示了在F(-)存在下，NDI单元发生两次连续的单电子转移，生成NDI⋅(-)和NDI(2-)。该过程抑制了从Ru(II)到NDI单元的初级电子转移，从而恢复配合物基于(3)MLCT的发射，导致发光强度相应增加十倍。DFT和TD-DFT计算研究进一步阐明了实验观察到的配合物吸收光谱。其次，使用UV-vis、PL和CD等多种光谱分析对配合物进行CT-DNA结合研究。通过EB和分子对接进行的比较性DNA结合研究表明，与CT-DNA的结合同时涉及嵌入和沟槽结合模式。第三，还展示了该配合物在有机交叉偶联反应中促进C-C、C-N和C-O键形成的光催化活性，包括α-酮酸与胺的酰胺化以及醇氧化为醛的反应。
